title: Industrial Ink

purpose.plainLanguage: A precise technical-instrument language for dense scientific, inspection, engineering, and operational workbenches.

jobs: Locate the current selection, accepted revision, named hold, and recovery route.
Connect a visual state with its evidence standing and responsible owner.

fits: Inspection, commissioning, engineering, and operational ledgers.
Dense controls and tabular values that need calm hierarchy.
